words.enDefinition: organising a program around objects that hold data and provide behaviour

examples.en: Our course introduced object-oriented programming through a small drawing app with several shape classes.
examples.zh: 课程通过一个包含几种图形类的小绘图应用介绍了「面向对象编程」。

examples.en: The tutor used object-oriented programming to keep each game piece's position with its movement rules.
examples.zh: 导师用「面向对象编程」把每个游戏棋子的当前位置和移动规则放在一起。

words.enDefinition: a language construct that defines a class and its members

examples.en: The Python class definition grouped the student's name with methods for recording attendance.
examples.zh: Python「类定义」把学生姓名和记录出勤的方法组织在一起。

examples.en: Our tutor moved the class definition above the example that created its first object.
examples.zh: 导师把「类定义」移到创建该类第一个对象的示例前面。

collocations: add a member to a class definition

words.enDefinition: the part of a class definition containing its members or statements

examples.en: In the Python exercise, the class body contained two definitions at the same indentation level.
examples.zh: 在 Python 练习中，「类体」内有两个缩进层级相同的定义。

examples.en: Our tutor added a field inside the class body before changing the example's constructor.
examples.zh: 导师先在「类体」内加了一个字段，然后才修改示例的构造方法。

collocations: put a method in the class body
the end of a class body

words.enDefinition: an individual object created from a class

examples.en: The exercise created a separate class instance for each book in the fictional library.
examples.zh: 练习为虚构图书馆中的每本书创建了独立的「类的实例」。

examples.en: Our tutor checked a class instance after changing its reading status in the program.
examples.zh: 导师在程序中改变一本书的阅读状态后，检查了一个「类的实例」。

words.enDefinition: to create a new object from a class

examples.en: The worksheet asked us to instantiate a class representing a recipe with a name.
examples.zh: 练习表要求我们「实例化一个类」，该类表示一份有名称的食谱。

examples.en: Our tutor showed how to instantiate a class twice and inspect the two objects.
examples.zh: 导师演示了怎样两次「实例化一个类」，并检查得到的两个对象。

collocations: instantiate a class for a test

words.enDefinition: the current values and relationships held by an object

examples.en: Our drawing exercise printed the object state before and after moving the sample rectangle.
examples.zh: 绘图练习在移动样本矩形之前和之后分别打印了「对象状态」。

examples.en: The tutor asked which part of the object state changed after a book was returned.
examples.zh: 导师问，还书后「对象状态」中的哪部分发生了变化。

words.enDefinition: a field, method, or other named element belonging to a class

examples.en: The Java worksheet asked which class member held the reading list's title for each object.
examples.zh: Java 练习表问，哪个「类成员」为每个对象保存阅读书单的标题。

examples.en: Our tutor identified each class member before explaining its role in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 导师先指出每个「类成员」，再解释它在课堂示例中的作用。

words.enDefinition: an attribute associated with a particular object, rather than with the class shared by its instances

examples.en: The Python example stored each book's title in an instance attribute on that object.
examples.zh: Python 示例把每本书的标题保存在该对象的一个「实例属性」中。

examples.en: Our tutor changed one instance attribute and checked that the second object's value stayed unchanged.
examples.zh: 导师修改一个「实例属性」，再确认第二个对象的值保持不变。

words.enDefinition: an attribute stored on a class and available through its instances

examples.en: The Python worksheet stored the default category as a class attribute for all sample books.
examples.zh: Python 练习表把样本书籍的默认类别存为一个「类属性」。

examples.en: Our tutor read the class attribute directly from the class before creating any objects.
examples.zh: 还没创建任何对象时，导师直接从类上读取了「类属性」。

words.enDefinition: an expression supplying a field's initial value at declaration

examples.en: The JavaScript example used a field initializer to give each reading counter an initial zero.
examples.zh: JavaScript 示例用「字段初始化表达式」将每个阅读计数器的初始值设为零。

examples.en: Our tutor moved the calculation into a field initializer beside the field's declaration.
examples.zh: 导师把计算移入字段声明旁的「字段初始化表达式」。

examples.en: The Java constructor received the shape's width and height when the sample rectangle was created.
examples.zh: 创建样本矩形时，Java「构造方法」接收了图形的宽和高。

examples.en: Our tutor stepped through the constructor to see when the object's title was assigned.
examples.zh: 导师逐步执行「构造方法」，查看对象标题何时被赋值。

words.enDefinition: a special class method that creates and initializes a new object instance
a method that sets up the state of an already created instance

examples.en: The Python example used an initializer method to set the title of each new library item.
examples.zh: Python 示例用「初始化方法」给每个新借阅项目设置标题。

examples.en: Our tutor identified __init__ as the initializer method called during construction of the example object.
examples.zh: 导师指出，__init__ 是构造示例对象过程中调用的「初始化方法」。

words.enDefinition: in Java, the constructor implicitly declared when an ordinary class declares no constructor

examples.en: The Java example received a default constructor because its class declared no constructor of its own.
examples.zh: Java 示例的类没有声明任何构造方法，因此获得了「默认构造方法」。

examples.en: Our tutor checked when the compiler would supply a default constructor for the simple class.
examples.zh: 导师核对编译器会在何种情况下为这个简单类提供「默认构造方法」。

words.enDefinition: a constructor that takes no arguments from its caller

examples.en: The Java class declared a no-argument constructor that assigned an empty label to each new shape.
examples.zh: Java 类声明了「无参构造方法」，给每个新图形赋予空标签。

examples.en: Our tutor used the no-argument constructor when the example did not supply any starting values.
examples.zh: 示例不提供任何初始值时，导师使用了「无参构造方法」。

collocations: a class with a no-argument constructor

words.enDefinition: a constructor with parameters for values supplied during object creation

examples.en: The sample class used a parameterized constructor to receive the title and starting page number.
examples.zh: 样本类用「带参构造方法」接收标题和起始页码。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which values the parameterized constructor needed to create the example rectangle.
examples.zh: 导师问，用「带参构造方法」创建示例矩形时需要哪些值。

words.enDefinition: providing several constructors with different parameter lists in one class

examples.en: The Java example used constructor overloading to create a circle with or without an explicit radius.
examples.zh: Java 示例用「构造方法重载」来创建圆，可以显式提供半径，也可以省略。

examples.en: Our tutor explained which parameter list distinguished the two versions in the constructor overloading exercise.
examples.zh: 导师解释了哪个参数列表区分了「构造方法重载」练习中的两个版本。

words.enDefinition: having one constructor invoke another as part of object setup

examples.en: The Java example used constructor chaining so one constructor could reuse the setup in another.
examples.zh: Java 示例用「构造方法链式调用」，让一个构造方法复用另一个的初始化工作。

examples.en: Our tutor drew the sequence of calls involved in constructor chaining for the sample shape.
examples.zh: 导师画出了样本图形的「构造方法链式调用」顺序。

words.enDefinition: a constructor that initialises a new object using another of the same type

examples.en: The Java example defined a copy constructor that created a new point from an existing point.
examples.zh: Java 示例定义了一个「复制构造方法」，用已有的点创建一个新点。

examples.en: Our tutor compared the two positions after the copy constructor built the second point.
examples.zh: 「复制构造方法」创建第二个点后，导师比较了两者的位置。

words.enDefinition: an alternative entry point that creates an instance from a different input form

examples.en: The Python sample used an alternate constructor to build a reading record from one line of text.
examples.zh: Python 样本用「替代构造入口」从一行文本创建一份阅读记录。

examples.en: Our tutor compared the alternate constructor with calling the class directly using separate values.
examples.zh: 导师比较了使用「替代构造入口」和用各个值直接调用类这两种方式。

collocations: a class method as an alternate constructor

words.enDefinition: a method called with a particular instance as its receiver

examples.en: The Python exercise called an instance method to move one shape to a new position.
examples.zh: Python 练习调用「实例方法」，把一个图形移到新位置。

examples.en: Our tutor checked which object received the instance method call in the drawing example.
examples.zh: 导师检查绘图示例中的哪个对象接收了这次「实例方法」调用。

words.enDefinition: a Python method that automatically receives the class as its first argument

examples.en: The Python example used a class method to create an object from an abbreviated name.
examples.zh: Python 示例用「类方法」根据一个简写名称创建对象。

examples.en: Our tutor showed which class the class method received when called through the inherited name.
examples.zh: 导师演示通过继承得来的名称调用「类方法」时，会收到哪个类。

collocations: the implicit argument to a class method

words.enDefinition: a method associated with a class that can be called without an instance

examples.en: The Java example used a static method to compare two measurements without creating a measurement object.
examples.zh: Java 示例直接用「静态方法」比较两个测量值，不需要先创建测量对象。

examples.en: The Python static method received only the measurement passed by our classroom script.
examples.zh: Python 的「静态方法」只接收课堂脚本显式传入的测量值。

words.enDefinition: the information identifying a method under a language's declaration rules

examples.en: The Java worksheet changed a parameter type to create a different method signature in the example.
examples.zh: Java 练习表修改了一个参数的类型，从而在示例中形成不同的「方法签名」。

examples.en: The Java example changed only the return type, so the method signature stayed the same.
examples.zh: Java 示例只改了返回类型，因此「方法签名」保持不变。

collocations: a method signature with two parameters

words.enDefinition: a method value that retains the instance or class it will receive

examples.en: Reading the method from the Python object produced a bound method in the classroom demonstration.
examples.zh: 在课堂演示中，从 Python 对象读取该方法得到一个「绑定方法」。

examples.en: We called the bound method later and checked that it still used the same instance.
examples.zh: 我们稍后调用了「绑定方法」，确认它仍在使用同一个实例。

words.enDefinition: the object or class a method call acts on

examples.en: The diagram linked the method receiver to the particular shape that moved in our example.
examples.zh: 示例图把「方法接收者」与实际移动的那个图形连了起来。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which object was the method receiver when the program called the stored method.
examples.zh: 导师问，程序调用保存的方法时，哪个对象是「方法接收者」。

collocations: the receiver of a method call

words.enDefinition: the association determining the value of this in a JavaScript call

examples.en: The worksheet traced how the call to a JavaScript method determined its this binding.
examples.zh: 练习表追踪了 JavaScript 方法调用如何确定「this 绑定」。

examples.en: Our tutor compared the this binding in a normal call with an explicitly bound call.
examples.zh: 导师把正常调用和显式绑定调用中的「this 绑定」作了比较。

collocations: the this binding of a JavaScript method

words.enDefinition: taking a method from an object and storing it separately

examples.en: The JavaScript sample used method extraction to save a drawing method in a separate variable.
examples.zh: JavaScript 样本通过「提取对象方法」，把一个绘图方法保存到单独的变量里。

examples.en: Our tutor asked how method extraction affected this when the saved function was later called.
examples.zh: 导师问，稍后调用保存的函数时，「提取对象方法」会怎样影响 this。

collocations: separate a method by method extraction

words.enDefinition: the process of finding an attribute requested by name

examples.en: The Python worksheet traced attribute lookup to show how an ordinary class attribute was found.
examples.zh: Python 练习表追踪了「属性查找」，展示如何找到普通类属性。

examples.en: Our tutor asked what attribute lookup returned after a new value was assigned to the instance.
examples.zh: 给实例赋新值后，导师问「属性查找」会返回什么。

words.enDefinition: a nearer attribute taking precedence over another with the same name

examples.en: The Python example illustrated attribute shadowing when an instance stored its own plain category attribute.
examples.zh: Python 示例通过给实例存入自己的普通类别属性，演示了「属性遮蔽」。

examples.en: Our tutor checked which label was returned after attribute shadowing occurred in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习出现「属性遮蔽」后，导师核实了实际返回哪个标签。

words.enDefinition: a method that exposes or computes a value for callers

examples.en: The Java sample used a getter method to return the book's title to the display.
examples.zh: Java 样本用「取值方法」把书名返回给显示模块。

examples.en: Our tutor checked whether the getter method returned the saved value or calculated it.
examples.zh: 导师核对「取值方法」返回的是保存的值还是计算得到的值。

collocations: return a value from a getter method

words.enDefinition: a method that changes a stored property through a defined interface

examples.en: The Java example used a setter method to update the label on a classroom shape.
examples.zh: Java 示例用「设值方法」更新课堂图形上的标签。

examples.en: Our tutor added a small validation check before the setter method assigned its new value.
examples.zh: 导师在「设值方法」写入新值之前加了一项简单的有效性检查。

collocations: validate input in a setter method

words.enDefinition: a property whose value is derived when it is read

examples.en: The JavaScript example used a computed property to return the area from two saved measurements.
examples.zh: JavaScript 示例用「计算属性」根据两个保存的测量值返回面积。

examples.en: Our tutor changed one dimension and checked the computed property on the same shape.
examples.zh: 导师改变其中一个尺寸，然后检查同一个图形的「计算属性」。

words.enDefinition: a property exposed for reading without a supported way to assign it

examples.en: The Python example exposed the total as a read-only property calculated from the scores.
examples.zh: Python 示例把从分数算出的总分作为「只读属性」提供给调用方。

examples.en: Our tutor used a read-only property when the exercise only needed to display the total.
examples.zh: 练习只需要显示总数时，导师使用了「只读属性」。

words.enDefinition: a condition that should hold for valid observable states of instances

examples.en: The drawing class maintained a class invariant requiring every stored width to be nonnegative.
examples.zh: 绘图类维持一个「类不变量」，要求保存的宽度始终非负。

examples.en: Our tutor checked the class invariant after each public operation in the small example.
examples.zh: 导师在小示例中每次执行公开操作后，都检查了「类不变量」。

words.enDefinition: a class primarily representing data in named fields, with generated common methods where the language or tool provides them

examples.en: The Python worksheet used a data class to hold a title and reading status.
examples.zh: Python 练习表用「数据类」存储标题和阅读状态。

examples.en: Our tutor showed which initialization code Python generated for the data class in the example.
examples.zh: 导师展示了 Python 为示例中的「数据类」生成了哪些初始化代码。

words.enDefinition: a Python method that defines behaviour for built-in language operations

examples.en: The tutor used a Python special method to customise how the sample object was displayed.
examples.zh: 导师用 Python 的「特殊方法」自定义样本对象的显示方式。

examples.en: Our worksheet connected the plus operator to a special method on the example measurement class.
examples.zh: 练习表把加号运算符与示例测量类上的一个「特殊方法」联系起来。

words.enDefinition: the sequence in which an object's parts receive their initial values

examples.en: The JavaScript worksheet compared initialization order for fields in the base and derived classes.
examples.zh: JavaScript 练习表比较基类和派生类字段的「初始化顺序」。

examples.en: Our tutor drew the initialization order before tracing when the example's label became available.
examples.zh: 导师先画出「初始化顺序」，再追踪示例中的标签何时可用。

words.enDefinition: grouping state with behaviour and controlling how callers use it

examples.en: The library example used encapsulation to keep borrowing status with the methods that changed it.
examples.zh: 图书馆示例用「封装」把借阅状态和改变该状态的方法放在一起。

examples.en: Our tutor explained how encapsulation let the class maintain valid values through its public operations.
examples.zh: 导师解释了「封装」如何让类通过公开操作维持有效的值。

words.enDefinition: keeping implementation choices out of a component's exposed contract

examples.en: The example used information hiding to let us change storage while keeping the same drawing methods.
examples.zh: 示例运用「信息隐藏」，让我们在保持绘图方法不变的情况下修改存储方式。

examples.en: Our tutor discussed information hiding before replacing the internal representation of each classroom shape.
examples.zh: 导师先讨论「信息隐藏」，再替换各课堂图形的内部表示。

words.enDefinition: a design choice inside a component that clients need not rely on

examples.en: The public drawing method stayed unchanged when the tutor replaced an implementation detail inside the class.
examples.zh: 导师替换类内部的一个「实现细节」时，公开绘图方法保持不变。

examples.en: We marked the choice of units as an implementation detail in the sample diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在样本图中把单位的选择标记为「实现细节」。

words.enDefinition: the way an object stores and organises its underlying data

examples.en: The class changed its internal representation from two measurements to a list of coordinates.
examples.zh: 这个类把「内部表示」从两个测量值改为一组坐标。

examples.en: Our tutor compared the internal representation of two shapes that shared the same drawing method.
examples.zh: 导师比较了两个共享同一绘图方法的图形的「内部表示」。

words.enDefinition: a member with access restricted to its declaring class context

examples.en: The Java example exposed the title through a method while keeping its field a private member.
examples.zh: Java 示例通过方法提供标题，同时让保存标题的字段保持为「私有成员」。

examples.en: Our tutor identified the private member used by the class to remember its current position.
examples.zh: 导师指出，类用哪个「私有成员」保存当前位置。

collocations: read a private member within its class
a private member of a class

words.enDefinition: a member declared publicly accessible under its language's rules

examples.en: The Java worksheet asked which public member a separate display class used to obtain the title.
examples.zh: Java 练习表问，另一个显示类使用哪个「公有成员」来获取标题。

examples.en: Our tutor checked whether the public member appeared in the available operations for the example.
examples.zh: 导师检查示例的可用操作里是否列出了该「公有成员」。

words.enDefinition: a member accessible in specified class, subclass, or package contexts

examples.en: The Java example let the subclass use a protected member while setting up the sample object.
examples.zh: Java 示例允许子类在初始化样本对象时使用一个「受保护成员」。

examples.en: Our tutor compared two references to the protected member in different Java package contexts.
examples.zh: 导师比较了两个 Java 包环境中对同一个「受保护成员」的引用。

collocations: a protected member inherited by a subclass

words.enDefinition: Java access limited to declarations within the same package

examples.en: Our Java worksheet used package-private access for a helper shared by classes in one package.
examples.zh: Java 练习表给同一个包内供多个类共享的辅助方法设了「包级访问权限」。

examples.en: The tutor showed how moving a class to another package affected package-private access in the example.
examples.zh: 导师演示了把类移到另一个包后，示例中的「包级访问权限」有什么变化。

words.enDefinition: a declaration keyword that controls where a member can be accessed

examples.en: The Java exercise changed an access modifier to let another package use the display method.
examples.zh: Java 练习修改了一个「访问修饰符」，让另一个包可以使用显示方法。

examples.en: Our tutor highlighted the access modifier before discussing which classes could call the sample method.
examples.zh: 导师高亮了「访问修饰符」，再讨论哪些类能调用样本方法。

words.enDefinition: representing essential features while hiding details irrelevant to the caller

examples.en: The tutor introduced abstraction by describing what all the example shapes could draw and measure.
examples.zh: 导师描述示例图形都能绘制和测量哪些内容，以此介绍「抽象」。

examples.en: Our class used abstraction to give different storage implementations the same set of visible operations.
examples.zh: 同学们用「抽象」让不同存储实现提供同一组可见操作。

words.enDefinition: a class intended for inheritance rather than direct creation of instances

examples.en: The Java example used an abstract class to share drawing setup among several shapes.
examples.zh: Java 示例用「抽象类」让几种图形共享绘制前的准备。

examples.en: Our tutor declared an abstract class before adding a concrete rectangle to the sample.
examples.zh: 导师先声明了一个「抽象类」，再在样本中添加一个具体矩形类。

collocations: behaviour shared by an abstract class

words.enDefinition: a class whose instances can be created directly when construction requirements are met

examples.en: The exercise created a concrete class implementing the remaining operations of the shape example.
examples.zh: 练习创建了一个「具体类」，实现图形示例中剩余的操作。

examples.en: Our tutor explained which concrete class the program instantiated for each sample shape.
examples.zh: 导师解释了程序为每种样本图形实例化的是哪个「具体类」。

collocations: a concrete class implementing an interface

words.enDefinition: a method declared as requiring a concrete implementation

examples.en: The Java worksheet declared an abstract method for drawing each type of classroom shape.
examples.zh: Java 练习表声明了一个「抽象方法」，用于绘制各种课堂图形。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which subclass supplied an implementation of the abstract method in the example.
examples.zh: 导师问，示例中哪个子类为「抽象方法」提供了实现。

words.enDefinition: a method with an implementation that can be executed

examples.en: The abstract class included a concrete method that returned the shape's label in our exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中的抽象类包含一个「具体方法」，用来返回图形的标签。

examples.en: Our tutor used the concrete method to share formatting among the example's different classes.
examples.zh: 导师用这个「具体方法」让示例中的不同类共享格式化逻辑。

words.enDefinition: a type specifying operations that implementing classes agree to support

examples.en: The Java example defined an interface for objects that could be drawn on the screen.
examples.zh: Java 示例为能够在屏幕上绘制的对象定义了一个「接口」。

examples.en: The timetable accepted either of the classroom room types through the same interface.
examples.zh: 课堂时间表通过同一个「接口」接收两种教室类型。

words.enDefinition: the operations and behavioural promises callers can rely on

examples.en: The interface contract said that the returned area would be measured in square centimetres.
examples.zh: 「接口契约」说明，返回的面积以平方厘米为单位。

examples.en: Our class checked whether both example implementations kept the same interface contract about empty lists.
examples.zh: 同学们核对两套示例实现是否遵守有关空列表的同一份「接口契约」。

words.enDefinition: to provide the operations specified by an interface

examples.en: The Java worksheet asked us to implement an interface for shapes with a measurable area.
examples.zh: Java 练习表要求我们为面积可计算的图形「实现一个接口」。

examples.en: Our tutor showed two ways to implement an interface while keeping the caller's code unchanged.
examples.zh: 导师展示了两种「实现一个接口」的方式，两种方式都保持调用方代码不变。

words.enDefinition: a Java interface method with a provided implementation

examples.en: The Java example declared a default method that supplied a standard label for new shapes.
examples.zh: Java 示例声明了一个「接口默认方法」，为新图形提供统一标签。

examples.en: Our tutor checked whether the implementing class inherited the default method from the drawing interface.
examples.zh: 导师核对实现类是否从绘图接口继承了「接口默认方法」。

words.enDefinition: an interface used to mark a type without declaring operations

examples.en: The Java worksheet showed a marker interface attached to types needing special treatment in the exercise.
examples.zh: Java 练习表展示了用于标示练习中需特殊处理类型的「标记接口」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked what the marker interface conveyed even though it declared no methods.
examples.zh: 导师问，「标记接口」没有声明方法，但它传达了什么信息。

collocations: a type with a marker interface

words.enDefinition: a Java interface with one abstract method under Java's counting rules

examples.en: The Java sample used a functional interface to represent one operation for scoring a guess.
examples.zh: Java 样本用「函数式接口」表示给一次猜测评分的操作。

examples.en: Our tutor matched the example lambda expression to the functional interface used by the exercise.
examples.zh: 导师把示例 lambda 表达式与练习所用的「函数式接口」对应起来。

collocations: a lambda for a functional interface

words.enDefinition: using a value according to what operations it supports

examples.en: The Python exercise used duck typing to draw objects that each supplied a draw method.
examples.zh: Python 练习用「鸭子类型」绘制各自提供 draw 方法的对象。

examples.en: Our tutor used duck typing when both unrelated classes supported the same operation in practice.
examples.zh: 两个无继承关系的类都支持同一操作时，导师使用了「鸭子类型」。

words.enDefinition: a relation allowing values of one type where another type is expected

examples.en: The assignment used subtyping when a specific drawing type was accepted as a general shape.
examples.zh: 在作业中，程序根据「子类型关系」把某个具体绘图类型当作通用图形接收。

examples.en: Our tutor illustrated subtyping with a Java class that implemented the required shape interface.
examples.zh: 导师用实现了所需图形接口的 Java 类说明「子类型关系」。

words.enDefinition: using a common operation with objects that provide different behaviour

examples.en: The drawing app used polymorphism to call the same operation for circles and rectangles.
examples.zh: 绘图应用利用「多态」对圆形和矩形调用同一个操作。

examples.en: Our tutor explained polymorphism after the two example shapes responded differently to the same request.
examples.zh: 两种示例图形对同一个请求作出不同行为后，导师解释了「多态」。

words.enDefinition: selecting a method implementation at runtime based on the receiver

examples.en: The Java example demonstrated dynamic dispatch when the shape reference pointed to a rectangle object.
examples.zh: 当图形引用指向矩形对象时，Java 示例演示了「动态分派」。

examples.en: Our tutor traced dynamic dispatch to find which drawing method ran for the sample object.
examples.zh: 导师追踪「动态分派」，找出样本对象实际执行的是哪个绘图方法。

collocations: a method chosen by dynamic dispatch

words.enDefinition: providing a subclass implementation for an inherited instance method

examples.en: The Java worksheet used method overriding to give the rectangle its own implementation of drawing.
examples.zh: Java 练习表用「方法重写」为矩形提供了自己的绘制实现。

examples.en: Our tutor explained how method overriding affected the operation chosen for the subclass instance.
examples.zh: 导师解释了「方法重写」如何影响为子类实例选择的操作。

words.enDefinition: declaring methods with one name and different parameter lists

examples.en: The Java exercise used method overloading to accept a pair of coordinates or a point.
examples.zh: Java 练习用「方法重载」接收一对坐标值或一个点对象。

examples.en: Our tutor compared the parameter types that distinguished the methods in the method overloading example.
examples.zh: 导师比较了「方法重载」示例中用来区分各方法的参数类型。

words.enDefinition: a subclass declaration obscuring an inherited method without dynamic overriding

examples.en: The Java example showed method hiding when both classes declared a static method named describe.
examples.zh: 当两个类都声明名为 describe 的静态方法时，Java 示例展示了「方法隐藏」。

examples.en: Our tutor used method hiding to explain why the reference type mattered for that static call.
examples.zh: 导师用「方法隐藏」解释为什么引用的类型对那次静态调用很重要。

words.enDefinition: the order in which a language searches classes for a method

examples.en: Our Python exercise printed the method resolution order before tracing a call to the sample method.
examples.zh: Python 练习先打印了「方法解析顺序」，再追踪对样本方法的调用。

examples.en: The tutor used method resolution order to locate the first implementation in the classroom hierarchy.
examples.zh: 导师用「方法解析顺序」在课堂示例的类层次结构中找到了第一个实现。

words.enDefinition: a class from which another class inherits

examples.en: The drawing exercise kept the shared label logic in a base class for all shapes.
examples.zh: 绘图练习把所有图形共用的标签逻辑放在一个「基类」里。

examples.en: Our tutor moved the common method to the base class before defining the second shape.
examples.zh: 导师先把共用方法移到「基类」，再定义第二种图形。

collocations: a method from the base class

words.enDefinition: a class derived from another class through inheritance

examples.en: The worksheet defined a rectangle subclass that reused the sample shape's label handling.
examples.zh: 练习表定义了矩形「子类」，复用样本图形处理标签的逻辑。

examples.en: Our tutor checked which methods the subclass received when it extended the base class.
examples.zh: 导师核对「子类」继承基类时获得了哪些方法。

collocations: override a method in a subclass

words.enDefinition: the arrangement of classes according to their inheritance relationships

examples.en: The class hierarchy diagram placed different kinds of shapes below their common general class.
examples.zh: 「类层次结构」图把不同类型的图形放在它们共同的通用类之下。

examples.en: Our tutor redrew the class hierarchy after adding a shared abstraction for the remaining shapes.
examples.zh: 导师为剩余图形添加共用抽象后，重新画了「类层次结构」。

collocations: a level in the class hierarchy

words.enDefinition: defining one class in terms of members or behaviour of another

examples.en: The example used inheritance to give two related shapes the same method for displaying labels.
examples.zh: 示例用「继承」让两种相关图形共用显示标签的方法。

examples.en: Our tutor discussed inheritance before deciding which behaviours belonged in the sample's general class.
examples.zh: 导师讨论了「继承」，然后决定样本通用类应包括哪些行为。

words.enDefinition: deriving one class directly from more than one base class

examples.en: The Python example used multiple inheritance to combine two independent features in a classroom object.
examples.zh: Python 示例用「多重继承」把两个独立功能结合到一个课堂对象里。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which base class supplied the method in the multiple inheritance exercise.
examples.zh: 导师问，「多重继承」练习中哪个基类提供了这个方法。

words.enDefinition: ambiguity when a class reaches the same ancestor through multiple inheritance paths

examples.en: The tutor drew two paths to the same ancestor to illustrate the diamond problem.
examples.zh: 导师画出通向同一祖先类的两条路径，说明「菱形继承问题」。

examples.en: Our exercise discussed the diamond problem before applying Python's method resolution rules to the example.
examples.zh: 练习先讨论了「菱形继承问题」，再将 Python 的方法解析规则用于示例。

words.enDefinition: the linked prototypes searched when resolving an object's property in JavaScript

examples.en: The JavaScript example found the drawing method farther up the object's prototype chain.
examples.zh: JavaScript 示例沿对象的「原型链」向上，在更远处找到了绘图方法。

examples.en: Our tutor sketched the prototype chain to show where the shared method was stored.
examples.zh: 导师画出「原型链」，说明共用方法存储在哪里。

collocations: an inherited method on the prototype chain

words.enDefinition: changing certain identifiers systematically to reduce name collisions

examples.en: The Python tutor used name mangling to discuss accidental name clashes between related classes.
examples.zh: Python 导师用「名称改写」说明相关类之间如何避免意外命名冲突。

examples.en: Our worksheet traced name mangling for a double-underscore attribute declared inside the sample class.
examples.zh: 练习表对样本类中声明的双下划线属性追踪了「名称改写」。

collocations: a name affected by name mangling

words.enDefinition: building an object out of other objects that provide parts of its behaviour

examples.en: The classroom app used object composition to give each drawing a separate colour palette.
examples.zh: 课堂应用用「对象组合」为每幅画配一套独立的调色板。

examples.en: Our tutor used object composition to combine a shape with a separate label object.
examples.zh: 导师用「对象组合」把一个图形和独立标签对象放在一起。

words.enDefinition: the principle of favouring collaborating objects when they offer simpler reuse than subclassing

examples.en: Our tutor illustrated composition over inheritance by giving each drawing a separate colour selector.
examples.zh: 导师为每幅画配上独立的颜色选择器，以说明「优先组合而非继承」。

examples.en: The class discussed composition over inheritance when the example needed several interchangeable label formats.
examples.zh: 示例需要多种可互换的标签格式时，同学们讨论了「优先组合而非继承」。

collocations: a design using composition over inheritance

words.enDefinition: a whole-part relationship in which parts can exist independently of the whole

examples.en: The UML example used object aggregation because the players could exist apart from any team.
examples.zh: UML 示例使用「对象聚合」，因为选手可以脱离任何队伍独立存在。

examples.en: Our tutor marked object aggregation on a diagram linking a reading group to its members.
examples.zh: 导师在阅读小组与成员的关系图上标出「对象聚合」。

collocations: a relationship based on object aggregation
show object aggregation on a diagram

words.enDefinition: a notation at one end of a class diagram's association showing how many instances may be linked

examples.en: The multiplicity indicator beside the classrooms showed that a tutor could be assigned to several rooms.
examples.zh: 教室一端的「关联多重性标记」显示，一名导师可获分配多间教室。

examples.en: Our class used a multiplicity indicator to show that some visitors had no associated booking in the example.
examples.zh: 我们班用「关联多重性标记」表示示例中有些访客没有关联的预订。

collocations: place a multiplicity indicator on an association
check the bounds of a multiplicity indicator

words.enDefinition: a relationship that can be followed from either of its ends

examples.en: The worksheet modelled a bidirectional association so each order and customer could find the other.
examples.zh: 练习表用「双向关联」建模，让订单和顾客能互相查到对方。

examples.en: Our tutor used a bidirectional association for a sample club that tracked members and their clubs.
examples.zh: 导师为记录成员及其所属社团的样本使用了「双向关联」。

words.enDefinition: a relationship in which one object holds or contains another

examples.en: The worksheet represented a has-a relationship by giving every drawing a separate palette object.
examples.zh: 练习表为每幅画配上独立的调色板对象，表示「拥有关系」。

examples.en: Our tutor drew a has-a relationship between a reading list and its title formatter.
examples.zh: 导师画出阅读清单和其标题格式化对象之间的「拥有关系」。

collocations: an example of a has-a relationship

words.enDefinition: a relationship where one type is a specialised kind of another

examples.en: The diagram showed an is-a relationship between the rectangle type and the general shape type.
examples.zh: 图示表明，矩形类型是通用图形类型的一种，这属于「是一种关系」。

examples.en: Our tutor used an is-a relationship to explain why a circle could be treated as a shape.
examples.zh: 导师用「是一种关系」解释为什么圆可以作为一种图形处理。

words.enDefinition: having one object ask a collaborator to perform part of its work

examples.en: The app used object delegation to give label formatting to a separate helper object.
examples.zh: 应用通过「对象委派」把标签格式化工作交给了一个独立的辅助对象。

examples.en: Our tutor demonstrated object delegation when the drawing let its palette choose a colour.
examples.zh: 绘图对象把颜色选择交给调色板时，导师演示了「对象委派」。

words.enDefinition: to pass a received method request on to another object

examples.en: The worksheet asked the wrapper to forward a call to the original drawing object.
examples.zh: 练习表要求包装对象向原来的绘图对象「转发调用」。

examples.en: Our tutor showed when to forward a call to the helper after recording the request.
examples.zh: 导师演示了记录请求后，何时向辅助对象「转发调用」。

collocations: forward a call to a delegate
forward a call to another object
forward a call with its arguments

words.enDefinition: an object that holds another object and exposes selected operations around it

examples.en: The example placed a wrapper object around a label so the display could add a prefix.
examples.zh: 示例用「包装对象」包住标签，让显示部分能够添加前缀。

examples.en: Our tutor compared the wrapper object's behaviour with the original object's output in the exercise.
examples.zh: 导师在练习中比较了「包装对象」的行为和原对象的输出。

collocations: a wrapper object around another object

words.enDefinition: a network of objects connected by references

examples.en: The object graph showed a reading list linked to its books and their shared formatter.
examples.zh: 「对象图」展示了阅读清单与书籍及其共用格式化对象之间的连接。

examples.en: Our tutor traced the object graph to find which objects shared the same example palette.
examples.zh: 导师沿着「对象图」查找哪些对象共用同一个示例调色板。

words.enDefinition: the stages from an object's creation through use to its disposal

examples.en: The object lifecycle diagram showed when the classroom drawing tool created and released each shape.
examples.zh: 「对象生命周期」图说明课堂绘图工具何时创建和释放各个图形。

examples.en: Our tutor divided the object lifecycle into creation, use, and cleanup for the example.
examples.zh: 导师把示例的「对象生命周期」分为创建、使用和清理三个阶段。

collocations: a stage of an object's lifecycle

words.enDefinition: a diagram showing classes, their members, and relationships

examples.en: The class diagram showed how the drawing class referred to a palette and several shapes.
examples.zh: 「类图」展示了绘图类如何引用一套调色板和多个图形。

examples.en: Our tutor added the missing association to the class diagram before checking the worksheet.
examples.zh: 导师先把缺失的关联加到「类图」上，再核对练习表。

words.enDefinition: which component relies on which other component

examples.en: The arrows showed the dependency direction from the drawing tool to its colour selector.
examples.zh: 箭头显示「依赖方向」是从绘图工具指向它的颜色选择器。

examples.en: Our tutor asked whether changing the dependency direction would simplify the example's object construction.
examples.zh: 导师问，改变「依赖方向」会不会简化示例中的对象构建。

words.enDefinition: a loop of object dependencies that returns to its starting point

examples.en: The workshop found a cyclic object dependency when each constructor required the other's instance.
examples.zh: 工作坊发现，每个构造方法都需要对方的实例，形成了「对象循环依赖」。

examples.en: We removed a cyclic object dependency by moving the shared calculation to a separate object.
examples.zh: 我们把共享计算移到独立对象中，消除了「对象循环依赖」。

collocations: a diagram of a cyclic object dependency

words.enDefinition: the design principle that high-level policy and low-level details depend on abstractions and those abstractions do not depend on implementation details

examples.en: The tutor used the dependency inversion principle to connect a drawing tool to interchangeable output objects.
examples.zh: 导师运用「依赖倒置原则」，让绘图工具连接可互换的输出对象。

examples.en: Our worksheet applied the dependency inversion principle by putting a common interface between the two classes.
examples.zh: 练习表通过在两个类之间设置公共接口，应用了「依赖倒置原则」。

collocations: an example of the dependency inversion principle

words.enDefinition: supplying an object's collaborators from outside its own implementation

examples.en: The sample used dependency injection to give the drawing tool a formatter chosen by the exercise.
examples.zh: 样本用「依赖注入」给绘图工具提供练习指定的格式化对象。

examples.en: Our tutor explained how dependency injection let the same class work with two output implementations.
examples.zh: 导师解释了「依赖注入」怎样让同一个类配合两种输出实现。

words.enDefinition: supplying required dependencies through arguments when an object is created

examples.en: The classroom example used constructor injection to provide the drawing class with a required palette.
examples.zh: 课堂示例用「构造方法注入」给绘图类提供必需的调色板对象。

examples.en: Our tutor checked whether constructor injection made each required collaborator visible in the parameter list.
examples.zh: 导师核对「构造方法注入」是否能在参数列表里列出每个必需的协作对象。

collocations: supply a dependency through constructor injection

words.enDefinition: supplying a dependency through a setter after constructing the object

examples.en: The example used setter injection to supply an optional label formatter after creating the shape.
examples.zh: 示例用「设值方法注入」，在创建图形之后提供可选的标签格式化对象。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which setter injection call gave the sample object its formatting helper.
examples.zh: 导师问，哪次「设值方法注入」调用为样本对象提供了格式化辅助对象。

collocations: provide a collaborator through setter injection

words.enDefinition: a component that builds objects and supplies their configured dependencies

examples.en: The class registered two example services with a dependency injection container before creating the drawing tool.
examples.zh: 同学们先把两个示例服务注册到「依赖注入容器」，再创建绘图工具。

examples.en: Our tutor traced how the dependency injection container assembled the formatter and the display object.
examples.zh: 导师追踪「依赖注入容器」怎样把格式化对象和显示对象组装起来。

collocations: register with a dependency injection container
objects built by a dependency injection container

words.enDefinition: giving control over some execution or setup to an external framework or component

examples.en: The classroom framework illustrated inversion of control by choosing when to call our drawing method.
examples.zh: 课堂框架通过决定何时调用我们的绘图方法，展示了「控制反转」。

examples.en: Our tutor used inversion of control to explain why the framework called the sample object.
examples.zh: 导师用「控制反转」说明为什么由框架调用样本对象。

collocations: a framework using inversion of control
an example of inversion of control

words.enDefinition: the place where an application assembles its main object graph

examples.en: The sample's composition root created the output helper and passed it to the drawing tool.
examples.zh: 样本的「对象组装入口」创建输出辅助对象，再把它传给绘图工具。

examples.en: Our tutor placed the composition root near startup so the object's dependencies were easy to locate.
examples.zh: 导师把「对象组装入口」放在启动部分附近，便于找到对象的依赖。

collocations: assemble dependencies in the composition root

words.enDefinition: a collaborator fixed inside a component's implementation

examples.en: The drawing class had a hard-coded dependency because it always constructed one particular helper class.
examples.zh: 绘图类有一个「写死的依赖」，因为它总是自行实例化同一个辅助类。

examples.en: Our tutor identified the hard-coded dependency before passing a formatter into the class from outside.
examples.zh: 导师先找出「写死的依赖」，再从外部给类传入格式化对象。

collocations: a hard-coded dependency on a concrete class

words.enDefinition: a design in which components rely on little knowledge of each other

examples.en: The worksheet used loose coupling so the same drawing tool could accept another palette implementation.
examples.zh: 练习表采用「松耦合」，让同一个绘图工具可以接收另一种调色板实现。

examples.en: Our tutor compared loose coupling with a version using one fixed helper inside every shape.
examples.zh: 导师比较了「松耦合」版本和每个图形都内置同一个固定辅助对象的版本。

words.enDefinition: a design where the parts of a component serve closely related responsibilities

examples.en: The tutor illustrated high cohesion with a class containing only closely related label formatting methods.
examples.zh: 导师用一个只包含紧密相关的标签格式化方法的类说明「高内聚」。

examples.en: To demonstrate high cohesion, we moved unrelated output work out of the drawing class.
examples.zh: 为说明「高内聚」，我们把无关的输出工作移出了绘图类。

words.enDefinition: the principle that clients should rely only on operations they need

examples.en: The worksheet applied the interface segregation principle by separating drawing operations from measurement operations.
examples.zh: 练习表将绘图和测量操作分开，应用了「接口隔离原则」。

examples.en: Our tutor used the interface segregation principle so a simple label needed only one operation.
examples.zh: 导师运用「接口隔离原则」，使简单的标签只需要一种操作。

collocations: an example of the interface segregation principle

words.enDefinition: the principle that a component should have one main reason to change

examples.en: The example followed the single responsibility principle by putting display and formatting in separate classes.
examples.zh: 示例将显示和格式化分到不同的类，遵循了「单一职责原则」。

examples.en: Our tutor applied the single responsibility principle when the two features changed for different reasons.
examples.zh: 两项功能因不同原因发生变化时，导师运用了「单一职责原则」。

words.enDefinition: the principle of designing components so supported new behaviour can be added through extension without modifying their established implementations

examples.en: The tutor applied the open-closed principle when adding a new shape through the existing interface.
examples.zh: 导师通过现有接口添加新图形，运用了「开闭原则」。

examples.en: Our worksheet used the open-closed principle to add another format while keeping the display class unchanged.
examples.zh: 练习表运用「开闭原则」添加另一种格式，同时保持显示类不变。

collocations: a design illustrating the open-closed principle

words.enDefinition: a principle requiring subtype instances to satisfy the behavioural expectations of their supertype's clients

examples.en: The class applied the Liskov substitution principle by testing both shapes against the same drawing expectations.
examples.zh: 同学们用同样的绘图预期测试两种图形，应用了「里氏替换原则」。

examples.en: Our tutor discussed the Liskov substitution principle when a subclass changed an established behaviour in the example.
examples.zh: 示例中的子类改变了一项已有行为时，导师讨论了「里氏替换原则」。

collocations: a violation of the Liskov substitution principle

words.enDefinition: five design principles for organising and evolving object-oriented code

examples.en: The class used the SOLID principles to review how the drawing example divided its work.
examples.zh: 同学们用「SOLID 五项原则」检查绘图示例怎样划分工作。

examples.en: Our tutor pointed to two SOLID principles that explained the changes to the sample classes.
examples.zh: 导师指出，可以用「SOLID 五项原则」中的两条来解释样本类的改动。

collocations: a design following the SOLID principles

words.enDefinition: an object representing a concept from the problem being modelled

examples.en: The library example treated a loan as a domain object with rules about returns.
examples.zh: 图书馆示例把借阅记录视为一个带有归还规则的「领域对象」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which domain object represented the student's place in the reading programme.
examples.zh: 导师问，哪个「领域对象」表示学生在阅读项目中的名额。

words.enDefinition: an object considered equivalent to another when their defining values match

examples.en: The drawing exercise modelled a point as a value object defined by its two coordinates.
examples.zh: 绘图练习用两个坐标定义点，将它建模为「值对象」。

examples.en: Our tutor compared two instances of the same value object using their stored measurements.
examples.zh: 导师根据保存的测量值，比较同一个「值对象」类型的两个实例。

words.enDefinition: a reusable approach to a design problem that occurs repeatedly

examples.en: The tutor introduced one design pattern through a reading app that needed several display formats.
examples.zh: 导师通过一个需要多种显示格式的阅读应用，介绍了一种「设计模式」。

examples.en: Our class discussed why a design pattern could work across languages with different class syntax.
examples.zh: 同学们讨论了为什么一种「设计模式」可用于采用不同类语法的语言。

words.enDefinition: a design pattern concerned with how objects are created

examples.en: The worksheet classified the builder as a creational pattern because it changed how objects were assembled.
examples.zh: 练习表将建造者归为「创建型模式」，因为它改变了对象的组装方式。

examples.en: Our tutor introduced a creational pattern for constructing objects from several pieces of input.
examples.zh: 导师介绍一种根据多项输入构建对象的「创建型模式」。

collocations: an example of a creational pattern

words.enDefinition: a design pattern concerned with how objects or classes are organised together

examples.en: The class treated the adapter as a structural pattern for connecting two incompatible interfaces.
examples.zh: 同学们把适配器看作一种用于连接两个不兼容接口的「结构型模式」。

examples.en: Our tutor picked a structural pattern to connect the drawing tool to its old display component.
examples.zh: 导师选用一种「结构型模式」，把绘图工具接到旧的显示组件上。

collocations: an example of a structural pattern

words.enDefinition: a design pattern for how objects divide work or communicate

examples.en: The class identified the observer as a behavioural pattern for passing changes to interested objects.
examples.zh: 同学们把观察者识别为一种把变更传给相关对象的「行为型模式」。

examples.en: Our tutor described a behavioural pattern before drawing the communication between the example's objects.
examples.zh: 导师先描述一种「行为型模式」，再画出示例对象之间的通信。

words.enDefinition: a design letting subclasses choose the concrete type created by a shared operation

examples.en: The factory method pattern let each worksheet class create its own type of example question.
examples.zh: 「工厂方法模式」让每种练习表类创建各自类型的示例题目。

examples.en: Our tutor traced the factory method pattern to see which subclass created the sample object.
examples.zh: 导师追踪「工厂方法模式」，找出哪个子类创建了样本对象。

collocations: an example of the factory method pattern

words.enDefinition: a class-level method that supplies an instance to callers

examples.en: The Java sample used a static factory method to create an object from two coordinate values.
examples.zh: Java 样本用「静态工厂方法」根据两个坐标值创建对象。

examples.en: Our tutor showed that the static factory method could return an existing immutable point in the exercise.
examples.zh: 导师展示了练习中的「静态工厂方法」可以返回已有的不可变点对象。

collocations: an instance returned by a static factory method

words.enDefinition: a design supplying related objects through a shared creation interface

examples.en: The abstract factory pattern produced matching labels and buttons for each classroom theme in the example.
examples.zh: 示例用「抽象工厂模式」为每套课堂主题生成相互配套的标签和按钮。

examples.en: Our tutor switched themes by replacing the factory in the abstract factory pattern demonstration.
examples.zh: 导师在「抽象工厂模式」演示中更换工厂，以切换主题。

collocations: a family of objects in the abstract factory pattern

words.enDefinition: a design that assembles a complex object through separate construction steps

examples.en: With the builder pattern, we added a title and optional notes before creating the worksheet.
examples.zh: 使用「建造者模式」时，我们先添加标题和可选备注，再创建练习表。

examples.en: Our tutor used the builder pattern to assemble two versions of the same sample report.
examples.zh: 导师用「建造者模式」组装同一份样本报告的两个版本。

collocations: construct an object with the builder pattern

words.enDefinition: an interface designed so calls can read as a connected sequence

examples.en: The Java example used a fluent interface to express several drawing settings in an easy sequence.
examples.zh: Java 示例用「流畅接口」把多项绘图设置写成易读的调用序列。

examples.en: Our tutor read the fluent interface example aloud to check whether the operations flowed naturally together.
examples.zh: 导师大声读出「流畅接口」示例，检查各操作连起来是否自然。

collocations: a fluent interface for configuring an object

words.enDefinition: calling methods in sequence on the values returned by previous calls

examples.en: The worksheet used method chaining to set the report title and add its first section.
examples.zh: 练习表用「方法链式调用」设置报告标题，并添加第一节。

examples.en: Our tutor showed which returned value made the next call possible in the method chaining example.
examples.zh: 导师展示了「方法链式调用」示例中，哪个返回值使下一次调用成为可能。

words.enDefinition: a design controlling object creation so there is one instance within a defined scope, with a way to access it

examples.en: The classroom example used the singleton pattern to share one colour registry across its drawing panels.
examples.zh: 课堂示例用「单例模式」，让各绘图面板共用一个颜色登记对象。

examples.en: Our tutor traced the singleton pattern to see which part controlled creation of the shared object.
examples.zh: 导师追踪「单例模式」，查看哪部分控制共享对象的创建。

collocations: a shared instance in the singleton pattern

words.enDefinition: a design that creates new objects by copying an existing example

examples.en: The prototype pattern created a second border by copying the classroom example's configured border object.
examples.zh: 「原型模式」通过复制课堂示例中已配置的边框对象创建第二个边框。

examples.en: Our tutor compared the copied shape with its original in the prototype pattern exercise.
examples.zh: 导师在「原型模式」练习中比较了复制后的图形和原图形。

collocations: clone an object using the prototype pattern
an example of the prototype pattern

words.enDefinition: a design that translates one object's interface into another expected interface

examples.en: The adapter pattern let our drawing tool call an older shape class through the new interface.
examples.zh: 「适配器模式」让绘图工具能通过新接口调用旧的图形类。

examples.en: Our tutor listed the translated operations while explaining the adapter pattern in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 导师解释练习表里的「适配器模式」时，列出了由适配器转换的操作。

collocations: an example of the adapter pattern

words.enDefinition: a design providing a simpler entry point to several underlying components

examples.en: The facade pattern gave the classroom display one operation for preparing and drawing the whole page.
examples.zh: 「外观模式」给课堂显示模块提供一个操作，用来准备并绘制整页。

examples.en: Our tutor used the facade pattern to hide the order of calls from the sample's client.
examples.zh: 导师用「外观模式」让样本的调用方无需了解内部调用顺序。

collocations: a subsystem using the facade pattern

words.enDefinition: adding behaviour by wrapping an object while keeping its basic interface

examples.en: The decorator pattern added a border around the sample label without changing the original label class.
examples.zh: 「装饰器模式」为样本标签加了一圈边框，同时保留原标签类的实现。

examples.en: Our tutor combined two wrappers to illustrate the decorator pattern in the drawing exercise.
examples.zh: 导师组合两个包装对象，说明绘图练习里的「装饰器模式」。

collocations: behaviour added through the decorator pattern

words.enDefinition: a design letting an abstraction and its implementation vary independently

examples.en: The bridge pattern let our example shapes work with either screen drawing or printed output.
examples.zh: 「桥接模式」让示例图形既能在屏幕绘制，也能用于打印输出。

examples.en: Our tutor used the bridge pattern to change the output method while keeping the shape class.
examples.zh: 导师通过「桥接模式」更换输出方式，同时保留图形类。

collocations: an example of the bridge pattern

words.enDefinition: a design notifying interested objects when another object changes

examples.en: The observer pattern updated both classroom displays after the sample score changed in the game.
examples.zh: 游戏样本的分数改变后，「观察者模式」更新了两个课堂显示组件。

examples.en: Our tutor drew the observer pattern to show which objects received the update message.
examples.zh: 导师画出「观察者模式」，说明哪些对象收到了更新消息。

collocations: objects notified through the observer pattern

words.enDefinition: a design making alternative algorithms interchangeable through a common interface

examples.en: The strategy pattern let the reading app use different operations for sorting the same titles.
examples.zh: 「策略模式」让阅读应用能用不同方式对同一批标题进行排序。

examples.en: Our tutor switched the selected algorithm during the strategy pattern demonstration without altering the caller.
examples.zh: 导师在「策略模式」演示中切换所选算法，调用方保持不变。

collocations: choose an algorithm through the strategy pattern

words.enDefinition: a design delegating behaviour to an object representing the current state

examples.en: The state pattern changed which operations a classroom ticket offered after it was marked used.
examples.zh: 一张课堂示例票标为已使用后，「状态模式」改变了它提供的操作。

examples.en: Our lending model used the state pattern to make returned books available for new loans.
examples.zh: 借阅模型通过「状态模式」，让已经归还的书可以重新借出。

words.enDefinition: a design keeping an operation's main sequence while subclasses supply selected steps

examples.en: The template method pattern kept the worksheet's steps in order while each subclass supplied different questions.
examples.zh: 「模板方法模式」保持练习表步骤的顺序，让各子类提供不同题目。

examples.en: Our tutor marked the shared steps before applying the template method pattern to the sample.
examples.zh: 导师先标出共用步骤，再将「模板方法模式」应用到样本。

collocations: shared steps in a template method pattern

words.enDefinition: a method called at a defined point to allow custom behaviour

examples.en: The base class called a hook method before displaying every worksheet in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 在课堂示例中，基类每次显示练习表前都会调用一个「钩子方法」。

examples.en: Our tutor supplied a hook method that added a short heading to one worksheet.
examples.zh: 导师提供了一个「钩子方法」，为其中一份练习表加上简短标题。

words.enDefinition: a design packaging a request as an object that can execute it

examples.en: The command pattern represented adding a shape as an object in a small classroom drawing exercise.
examples.zh: 在一项简易课堂绘图练习里，「命令模式」以一个对象表示添加图形这项操作。

examples.en: Our tutor traced when the command pattern passed the request to the drawing object.
examples.zh: 导师追踪「命令模式」何时将请求交给绘图对象。

collocations: requests represented through the command pattern

words.enDefinition: a design treating individual objects and groups through the same interface

examples.en: The composite pattern let the drawing tool move single shapes and groups through one operation.
examples.zh: 「组合模式」让绘图工具通过同一个操作移动单个图形或一组图形。

examples.en: Our tutor used the composite pattern to display a group together with its smaller groups.
examples.zh: 导师用「组合模式」显示一个分组及其中较小的分组。

collocations: a hierarchy using the composite pattern

words.enDefinition: a design placing operations that act on an object structure in separate objects

examples.en: The visitor pattern let us add a counting operation to the example's existing shape structure.
examples.zh: 「访问者模式」让我们可以给示例已有的图形结构增加一个计数操作。

examples.en: Our tutor used the visitor pattern to calculate totals for several kinds of classroom shapes.
examples.zh: 导师用「访问者模式」计算几种课堂图形的汇总值。

collocations: operations organised through the visitor pattern

words.enDefinition: a design centralising coordination among objects in a dedicated component

examples.en: The mediator pattern let the sample drawing panels coordinate through a single classroom controller.
examples.zh: 「中介者模式」让样本的各绘图面板通过一个课堂控制器协调。

examples.en: Our tutor used the mediator pattern to trace how a selection reached the other components.
examples.zh: 导师用「中介者模式」追踪某个选择如何传到其他组件。

collocations: interactions managed through the mediator pattern

words.enDefinition: a design passing a request along possible handlers until one handles it

examples.en: The class used a chain of responsibility to pass each worksheet request to a suitable handler.
examples.zh: 同学们用「责任链模式」把每项练习表请求传给适合的处理者。

examples.en: Our tutor drew the chain of responsibility to show where the sample request stopped.
examples.zh: 导师画出「责任链模式」，说明样本请求在哪里停止传递。

collocations: handlers in a chain of responsibility

words.enDefinition: a design saving an object's state so it can later be restored

examples.en: The memento pattern let the drawing example restore the earlier positions of its shapes.
examples.zh: 「备忘录模式」让绘图示例可以恢复图形先前的位置。

examples.en: Our tutor used the memento pattern to illustrate one level of undo in the sample.
examples.zh: 导师用「备忘录模式」演示样本中的一次撤销。

collocations: restore state using the memento pattern

words.enDefinition: a design providing an object with default behaviour for an absent collaborator

examples.en: The null object pattern supplied a label formatter that simply returned the original text.
examples.zh: 「空对象模式」提供一个直接返回原文本的标签格式化对象。

examples.en: Our tutor used the null object pattern so the drawing exercise could call the optional helper consistently.
examples.zh: 导师使用「空对象模式」，让绘图练习始终以同样的方式调用可选辅助对象。

collocations: a default collaborator in the null object pattern

words.enDefinition: a design separating the model and its behaviour, the view that presents it, and the controller handling input

examples.en: The classroom reading app used model-view-controller to keep the view separate from book data.
examples.zh: 课堂阅读应用使用「模型视图控制器模式」，把视图与书籍数据分开。

examples.en: Our tutor drew a model-view-controller diagram to show which part handled the student's action.
examples.zh: 导师画了「模型视图控制器模式」示意图，说明哪个部分处理学生的操作。

words.enDefinition: a design exposing domain objects through a collection-like storage interface

examples.en: The repository pattern let the reading app request books without specifying where they were stored.
examples.zh: 「仓储模式」让阅读应用可以请求书籍，无需指明书籍存在哪里。

examples.en: Our tutor used the repository pattern to replace the sample storage with an in-memory collection.
examples.zh: 导师用「仓储模式」把样本的存储实现换成内存集合。

collocations: a storage interface using the repository pattern
